subject: french
title: Describing Family
welcome_lead: How big is your family? Talking about people.
meta_desc: KS3 French: describing family, age, ages, sizes.
final_note: Put words together to describe your family.

walkthroughs.body_html: 'Dans ma famille il y a quatre personnes' = In my family there are four people. Use il y a + number + people.
'My' changes with the gender: mon pere (m), ma mere (f), mes parents (plural). Match 'my' to the noun.
'J'ai un frere. Il s'appelle Tom' = 'I have a brother. He is called Tom'. Combine 'j'ai' with family vocab and names to describe everyone.

mcqs.q: What tense follows 'depuis' for ongoing situations in French?
options: Present tense (J'habite ici DEPUIS 5 ans - I have lived here for 5 years).
Past tense (because it is translated as 'have lived' in English).

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I'm going to my friend's house' in French?
options: Je vais à la maison de mon ami.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'his sister' and 'her sister' in French?
options: Both are 'sa sœur' - possessives agree with the OBJECT possessed, not the owner.
His = son, her = sa - based on owner's gender.
